product_metadata.title: Electric Garlic Chopper Mini Food Chopper with USB Charging, Portable Mini Food Processor, Onion Chopper Electric Mini Chopper for Vegetables, Salad, Chili Minced Meat and Spices (White, 250ML)
features: 【No More Cable Mess】The electric vegetable chopper supports USB charging, and it can be used about 50 times after fully charged for 2-3 hours. The lightweight and stylish design of the garlic chopper is very suitable for traveling, family outdoor meals, camping, or other outdoor activities.

【Multi Purpose Mini Garlic Chopper】As a compact and lightweight electric mini food processor, it is perfect for small jobs, like chopping garlic, ginger, peppers, carrots, vegetables, onions, minced meat and more.

【One Touch Operation Electric Mini Food Chopper】 The vegetable chopper supports a one-click start or shutdown and you can control the degree of food shredding as you like. The mini garlic chopper is designed with a magnetic child safety lock, which ensures that the garlic chopper won’t start without closing the cover.

【Premium Safe Garlic Chopper】This electric mini garlic chopper is equipped with a Food Grade mixing cup, 304 stainless steel blade, BPA-free cup body. Our portable mini food processor is non-slip bottom, and non-toxic plastic, which is harmless to your family and children and an ideal choice to store food.
【Easy to Clean】The electric mini food chopper comes in 3 parts, which makes assembling and cleaning very easy.
